paragraphs: Yalta, Rav Nachman’s wife; see his entry. The cited Gilgulei Neshamot identifies her as the reincarnation of Maakhah, Asa’s mother, and interprets Maakhah’s cult image as having a sexual purpose. She too desired forbidden things, as in Chullin 109b, where she said, ‘I wish to eat meat in milk.’ She was rectified through Rav Nachman’s merit (ג״נ [Gilgulei Neshamot, Yod 8]).
